전용 목적 설명: Make foreign-language content in the user-selected webpage understandable through on-device audio subtitles and image-text translation in Korean, English or Japanese. Movable captions, inline corrections, local text history and explicit PNG export support that same purpose. No microphone capture or server-side inference.
activeTab 사용 근거: The user invokes Jamak for the current tab. activeTab grants temporary access to select images, display local audio/image text overlays and capture the visible portion of a cross-origin image when its pixels cannot be read directly. Screenshots are processed locally and are not uploaded. Jamak does not request persistent access to ordinary websites.
scripting 사용 근거: Inject packaged audio-caption and image-translation overlays into the user-selected tab after the user invokes Jamak. Packaged code discovers displayed images, lets the user select one, reads available image pixels and displays movable/editable translated text. No remotely hosted JavaScript is injected.
tabCapture 사용 근거: Capture audio from the tab explicitly selected by the user for local speech recognition, translation and speaker-color assignment. Capture starts only after Start and ends on Stop, navigation or target loss. Captured audio is not uploaded or saved as recordings.
offscreen 사용 근거: A packaged offscreen document hosts tab capture/playback, local speech/translation workers, the permissionless OCR sandbox, model downloads and explicit PNG generation after the popup closes. It keeps local processing alive without a separate app. Stop/navigation releases inference resources; completed text or image results can remain in memory for history or export.
notifications 사용 근거: Show one local desktop notification after the audio/translation and OCR models selected in Advanced have all finished preparing, even if the settings window closed. Stop, failed preparation and automatic cache checks do not notify. Notifications contain no audio, image or transcript content.
호스트 권한 사용 근거: Download only pinned PP-OCRv5/PP-OCRv6 model archives from PaddlePaddle's official paddle-model-ecology.bj.bcebos.com host, whose archive responses lack CORS headers. Exact file size and SHA-256 are verified and files are cached locally. This permission grants no access to ordinary websites. Images, screenshots, OCR text, audio and translations are never sent to this host; inference runs on the user's device.
